verdict.rationale: The CLI documents several bulk operations. Users can install every skill in a repo with `'*'`, pass repeated `--skill` and `-a` flags to install many skills to many agents at once, run `skills update` with no arguments to update everything or name several skills, remove a skill from several agents in one command, and restore a whole set from `skills-lock.json`. A runtime probe confirms it enumerates all skills in a repo and runs non-interactively when driven by an agent. Community complaints about updates are general skepticism, not a concrete failure. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of bulk install, update and remove actually running across many items, and an explicit remove-all or bulk-uninstall option.
